show.description: Krishna, a mysterious kickboxing specialist and a shadow warrior, with a forgotten past, becomes the protector of Veda Sreekanth, a brilliant pharma CEO who has discovered a cancer cure. As they navigate their intertwined destinies, they uncover a love story and a decades-old vendetta that have bound them long before fate brought them together.
